title: Connecting Universal Ads to Your AI Tools: The Universal Ads MCP Beta

facts.fact: The Universal Ads blog post announcing the MCP beta is dated September 15, 2026.
Universal Ads describes its platform as built API-first from day one, meaning every core capability including campaign management, reporting, and audience targeting is accessible programmatically.
facts.quote: From day one, Universal Ads was built API-first, meaning every core capability – from campaign management to reporting to audience targeting – is accessible programmatically.

facts.fact: Universal Ads describes MCP (Model Context Protocol) as an open standard for connecting AI tools to external data sources.
facts.quote: MCP (Model Context Protocol, an open standard for connecting AI tools to external data sources)

facts.fact: Universal Ads says its initial MCP release is a local connector offered as an extension of its existing developer toolkit.
facts.quote: we're releasing a local MCP (Model Context Protocol, an open standard for connecting AI tools to external data sources) connector as an extension of our existing developer toolkit.

facts.fact: Universal Ads says the first MCP release is built specifically for technically-minded partners and developers.
facts.quote: This first release is built specifically for technically-minded partners and developers

facts.fact: Universal Ads says the initial MCP release supports natural-language querying of campaign performance data.
facts.quote: query performance data in natural language

facts.fact: Universal Ads says it is only testing AI connectors that would enable creating, launching, and optimizing campaigns, so these functions are not part of the initial MCP release.
facts.quote: also testing AI connectors that would enable creating, launching, and optimizing campaigns.

facts.fact: Universal Ads directs developers to a GitHub repository for MCP setup instructions.
facts.quote: for setup instructions and let us know what you build.
